title: Seeing Hands
question: How did Vera disover she had this gift of second sight?

meanings.usage: 指发现不易被注意到的事物、现象或问题，可接名词或从句作宾语
可修饰物体的形态、质地，也可表示“可靠的”
强调通过感官或直觉意识到事物，可接名词、that从句或wh-从句
指用于存放贵重物品的防盗容器，作形容词时意为“安全的”
常与of搭配，a bundle of表示“一捆/一包某物”
可指天生具备的某种能力，have a talent for表示“有……的天赋”
多指教育、科研等专业机构
此处指官方成立的专门委员会，作“佣金”讲时不可数
可修饰物体，也可指语言、含义晦涩难理解
指手臂关节处，也可作动词表示“用肘挤”
通常指女士穿的长筒袜，常用复数形式
通常指室内穿的拖鞋，常用复数形式
可指物体的外部形状，也可指文章、计划的要点
是形容词sensitive的名词形式，可表示感官、仪器的灵敏度
作名词时指蒙眼布，作动词时表示“蒙住……的眼睛”

phrases.usage: 固定表达，指预见未来的能力，或文中提到的“第二视觉”（不用眼睛看就能感知事物的能力）

examples.en: Some people believe that certain psychics have second sight.
examples.zh: 一些人相信某些灵媒有预知能力。

phrases.usage: 表示“与……相关；涉及”，常用于介绍某个事件、情况的对象

examples.en: The report concerns the problem of air pollution in cities.
examples.zh: 这份报告涉及城市空气污染的问题。

phrases.usage: 表示“碰巧做某事；偶然发生某事”，强调偶然性

examples.en: I happened to meet my former teacher in the supermarket yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天在超市碰巧遇到了我以前的老师。

phrases.usage: 此处表示“捆；包；整理”，还可表示“扣上；修缮”

examples.en: Please do up these books and send them to the rural school.
examples.zh: 请把这些书捆好，寄给那所乡村学校。

phrases.phrase: bring sth to the notice of sb
phrases.usage: 表示“使某人注意到某事”，是被动语态常用结构

examples.en: The student's excellent performance brought him to the notice of the professor.
examples.zh: 这个学生的出色表现让教授注意到了他。

phrases.usage: 表示“一系列；一连串”，后接可数名词复数

examples.en: The school will hold a series of activities to celebrate its 100th anniversary.
examples.zh: 学校将举办一系列活动来庆祝建校100周年。

phrases.usage: 此处表示“辨认出；看出”，还可表示“理解；填写”

examples.en: It was so dark that I could hardly make out the road sign ahead.
examples.zh: 天太黑了，我几乎看不清前面的路标。

phrases.usage: 引导时间状语从句，表示“一……就……”，相当于as soon as

examples.en: The moment I got home, it began to rain heavily.
examples.zh: 我一到家，就开始下大雨了。

sentences.en: Several cases have been reported in Russia recently of people who can read and detect colours with their fingers, and even see through solid doors and walls.
sentences.zh: 最近，俄罗斯报道了几宗这类事例，有人能用手指阅读和辨认颜色，甚至能看穿厚实的门和墙壁。

sentences.en: One case concerns an 11-year-old schoolgirl Vera Petrova,
sentences.zh: 其中有一例是关于一个名叫维拉·彼得洛娃的11岁女学生。

sentences.en: who has normal vision but who can also perceive things with different parts of her skin, and through solid walls.
sentences.zh: 她视力正常，但也同样能用皮肤的不同部位感知事物，并能看穿厚实的墙壁。

sentences.en: This ability was first noticed by her father.
sentences.zh: 她父亲首先发现了她的这种能力。

sentences.en: One day she came into his office and happened to put her hands on the door of a locked safe.
sentences.zh: 有一天，她走进她父亲的办公室，偶然把手放在一个锁着的保险柜的门上。

sentences.en: Suddenly she asked her father why he kept so many old newspapers locked away there,
sentences.zh: 突然，她问父亲为什么把那么多旧报纸锁在里面，

sentences.en: and even described the way they were done up in bundles.
sentences.zh: 她甚至说出了报纸捆扎的方式。

sentences.en: Vera's curious talent was brought to the notice of a scientific research institute in the town of Ulyanovsk, near where she lives,
sentences.zh: 维拉的特异功能引起了她家附近，乌里扬诺夫斯克镇一家科研机构的注意。

sentences.en: and in April she was given a series of tests by a special commission of the Ministry of Health of the Russian Federal Republic.
sentences.zh: 四月份，俄罗斯联邦共和国卫生部的一个特别委员会对她进行了一系列的测试。

sentences.en: During these tests she was able to read a newspaper through an opaque screen and, stranger still,
sentences.zh: 在这些测试中，她能隔着不透明的屏幕阅读报纸；更奇怪的是，

sentences.en: by moving her elbow over a child's game of Lotto she was able to describe the figures and colours printed on it;
sentences.zh: 她把胳膊肘放在儿童玩的“乐透”纸牌上，竟能说出上面印着的数字和颜色；

sentences.en: and, in another instance, wearing stockings and slippers,
sentences.zh: 还有一次，她穿着长筒袜和拖鞋，

sentences.en: to make out with her foot the outlines and colours of a picture hidden under a carpet.
sentences.zh: 用脚辨认出了藏在地毯下面的一幅画的轮廓和颜色。

sentences.en: Other experiments showed that her knees and shoulders had a similar sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 其他实验表明，她的膝盖和肩膀也有类似的敏感性。

sentences.en: During all these tests Vera was blindfold; and indeed, except when blindfold she lacked the ability to perceive things with her skin.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些实验中，维拉都是被蒙住眼睛的；的确，除了被蒙住眼睛，她就不具备用皮肤感知事物的能力。

sentences.en: It was also found that although she could perceive things with her fingers this ability ceased the moment her hands were wet.
sentences.zh: 人们还发现，尽管她能用手指感知事物，但她的手一湿，这种能力就消失了。

exercises.prompt: “固体的；实心的；坚固的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: solid · /ˈsɒlɪd/ · adjective · 固体的；实心的；坚固的。可修饰物体的形态、质地，也可表示“可靠的”

exercises.prompt: “表示主语是动作的承受者，强调动作的承受者或者不需要指出动作的执行者” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: be + 动词过去分词 + （by + 动作执行者）
options: so that引导的结果状语从句
条件状语从句的真实条件句（零/第一条件句）
if引导的非真实条件句（虚拟语气）

grammar.title: 定语从句（定语后置分隔）
grammar.definition: 定语从句通常紧跟在先行词之后，但当先行词的定语较短时，为了避免句子头重脚轻，会将定语从句与先行词分隔开
grammar.structure: 名词 + 介词短语/其他短定语 + 定语从句
grammar.usage: 用于修饰前面的名词，解决长定语导致的句子结构失衡问题，翻译时需先判断先行词，再将定语含义补充到先行词前

examples.en: Several cases have been reported in Russia recently of people who can read and detect colours with their fingers.
examples.zh: 最近俄罗斯报道了几起人们能用手指阅读和辨认颜色的案例。

examples.en: I bought a picture yesterday which was painted by a famous artist.
examples.zh: 我昨天买了一幅由著名艺术家绘制的画。

grammar.title: 被动语态
grammar.definition: 表示主语是动作的承受者，强调动作的承受者或者不需要指出动作的执行者
grammar.structure: be + 动词过去分词 + （by + 动作执行者）
grammar.usage: 常用于新闻、科普等正式文体中，突出客观事实，避免主观语气

examples.en: Vera's curious talent was brought to the notice of a scientific research institute.
examples.zh: 薇拉奇特的天赋引起了一家科学研究所的注意。

examples.en: The new library will be completed next month.
examples.zh: 新图书馆将于下个月完工。

patterns.pattern: One case concerns + 名词/名词短语, who/which + 定语从句

original.en: One case concerns an 11-year-old schoolgirl Vera Petrova, who has normal vision but who can also perceive things with different parts of her skin, and through solid walls.
original.zh: 其中一个案例涉及一名11岁的女学生薇拉·佩特洛娃，她视力正常，但也能用身体不同部位的皮肤感知事物，并且能透过实心墙看东西。

examples.en: One case concerns a 7-year-old boy, who has a poor memory but can remember all the details of the paintings he has seen once.
examples.zh: 其中一个案例涉及一名7岁的男孩，他记忆力很差，但能记住他只见过一次的画作的所有细节。

examples.en: One case concerns a small coastal village, which has only 300 residents but attracts thousands of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 其中一个案例涉及一个沿海小村庄，它只有300名居民，但每年吸引数千名游客。

patterns.pattern: It was also found that + 主语从句, although + 让步状语从句

original.en: It was also found that although she could perceive things with her fingers this ability ceased the moment her hands were wet.
original.zh: 人们还发现，虽然她能用手指感知事物，但她的手一湿，这种能力就消失了。

examples.en: It was also found that although the new drug can relieve pain effectively, it has obvious side effects on the elderly.
examples.zh: 人们还发现，虽然这种新药能有效缓解疼痛，但它对老年人有明显的副作用。

examples.en: It was found that although the device is very convenient to carry, its battery life is less than 5 hours.
examples.zh: 人们发现，虽然这个设备携带起来很方便，但它的续航时间不到5小时。
